review_method: Three distinct reviewers independently opened actual contact sheets and full-resolution selected PNGs. First opinions were collected before sharing for cross-review. PD also opened all eight contact sheets. Findings concern extracted visual samples, not uninterrupted playback or actual listening.

clips.finding: Four-second threat is sustained without premature roof grabbing/lifting. Neck, building and distant observers remain coherent in inspected samples.
conditions: Exclude later leaning/reaching.
Verify hook caption reading time in the final composite.

clips.finding: Earcup remains beside the ear; hand separates around 3 seconds. Previous muzzle-cover appearance is improved. S-neck and both supporting hands remain.
conditions: Treat the start as final adjustment, not a complete from-scratch installation.
Place the question caption after the hand leaves, allowing about two seconds.

clips.finding: Two-hand support resumes around 1.5 seconds and persists without the previous late stand-up/roof lift.
conditions: Join to the previous thumb response without duplicating the thumb action.
Final trim is not locked; inspect palm position and posture at the join.
A 4.8-second end-title interval may use the stable later section, subject to composition/readability verification.

clips.finding: Automatic stabilizer/jack deformation not found in inspected samples, but the technician rests a foot on the lower frame and the ladder moves again near the end. Manual brake press-release-park is not established.
conditions: Use movement only; do not label it successful locking.
Retain time ellipsis before climbing/earcup installation.

clips.finding: A small outward step retains one porch and S-neck in the early section. Later knees straighten and hands approach the face. The original file plays in normal direction.
conditions: No reverse derivative was made in this run.
Before use, test reversed foot contact, weight shift and K02A/K03 continuity.
This does not establish complete entry beneath the porch; retain existing time ellipsis until verified.

clips.finding: Ghost raises/drops a brown file around 1–1.25 seconds instead of simply jolting the desk. Employee paper sorting is faster and coherent, ending around 2.5–3 seconds.
conditions: Keep the existing K02 structure as default; the new sorting section is an alternate only.
If joined to the older attack, inspect file/pad presence, paper position and hand continuity.
Place the thanks caption after sorting; do not claim desk-jolt action or its causal relationship has been fixed.

clips.finding: Pen contact, short mark and hand withdrawal reveal the check area. Clear monitor glance occurs after checking, not before. No major hand/pen/paper breakup found in inspected samples. Original has no audio stream.
conditions: Present the comparison in the existing preceding shot before this check insert.
Composite matching original-record/AI-proposal information on monitor and paper.
Replace or integrate the generated small mark without a duplicate check; mask the pen/hand correctly.
Keep explanatory captions clear of the paper and check action.

clips.finding: Initial smile briefly broadens; later mouth corners fall and face becomes clearly dismayed. Face, hair, robe and foreground visitor fragment remain coherent in inspected samples.
conditions: Exclude early broad smile/head dip.
Place after the existing seated wide shot and verify eyeline/posture at the join.
Reserve a separate 4.8-second readable ending; do not obscure the reaction with title typography.

outcome: Eight original source clips preserved and reviewed; three limited-action cases remain explicitly constrained. This is not approval of complete finished films.
